steps.title: Lay out the parts
steps.instruction: Spread a blanket or the flattened box on the floor. Lay the tabletop on it with the finished top facing down, so the side with a hole near each corner faces up. Set the four legs and four fasteners beside it.
steps.completionCheck: The tabletop lies on a soft surface with four corner holes facing up, and you have four legs and four fasteners.

substeps.instruction: Find the parts: one large square tabletop, four square legs, and four short metal fasteners threaded at both ends (part 115980).
Put down a blanket or the flattened cardboard box so the finished top doesn't get scratched.
Lay the tabletop finished side down. You should now see a hole near each corner.

steps.title: Start the first fastener
steps.instruction: Set one end of a fastener into the front-left corner hole and turn it clockwise by hand until it holds firmly and stands straight up. The other threaded end stays exposed for the leg.
steps.completionCheck: The fastener stands straight up in the front-left hole, doesn't wobble, and its other end sticks out.

substeps.instruction: Hold the fastener upright and set one threaded end into the front-left hole. Keep it straight up and down, not tilted.
Turn it clockwise by hand. If it doesn't catch within one turn, lift it out and set it straight again instead of pushing harder.
Keep turning until it holds firmly. Stop when it gets hard to turn. Don't use tools or force it.

steps.title: Attach the first leg
steps.instruction: Hold a leg straight up with its hole facing down over the fastener in the front-left corner. Turn the leg clockwise by hand until it sits flat against the tabletop.
steps.completionCheck: The leg sits flat against the tabletop with no gap and doesn't wobble when you push it gently.

substeps.instruction: Find the hole in one end of the leg. Hold the leg straight up and lower that hole onto the fastener sticking out of the front-left corner.
Keep the leg straight up and down as you start turning it clockwise. If it tilts or scrapes, lift it off and line it up again.
Keep turning until the end of the leg sits flat on the tabletop. Stop when it's snug; don't force it.

steps.title: Turn the table over
steps.instruction: Lift the table by the tabletop, with a second person if you can, and turn it over so it stands on its legs. Set it down gently on all four legs at once.
steps.completionCheck: The table stands on all four legs with the finished top facing up.

substeps.instruction: Hold the edges of the tabletop rather than the legs while you lift.
Turn it over and lower it so all four legs touch the floor together.

steps.title: Check the table
steps.instruction: Look at each leg from the side; each should sit flat against the tabletop. If one is loose, turn the table back over and tighten that leg by hand.
steps.completionCheck: All four legs are snug and the table doesn't rock when you press on a corner.

substeps.instruction: Press gently on each corner of the top. The table should stay steady.

usageNotes: Keep the load on the tabletop to 22 lb (10 kg) or less.
